rows.name: enemy sprite layout table
rows.notes: Super Mario Bros. (World) PRG ROM table of 6-byte sprite/metasprite layouts: each entry lists the CHR tile ids the game draws for one sprite form, in draw order. The bytes are consecutive tile ids (e.g. $FC,$FC,$70,$71,$72,$73), $FC being the blank filler tile for the unused third row of a 16x24 form. WHERE THE GOOMBA'S ENTRY IS: prgRom 0x6792 (CPU $E792) = FC FC 70 71 72 73 - two $FC top fillers then the Goomba's four body tiles $70 (upper-left dome), $71 (upper-right), $72 (lower-left feet), $73 (lower-right). The table is a run of such 6-byte entries on a fixed 6-byte grid observed from prgRom 0x6744 through 0x683D (0x683E onward is small signed data, not sprite forms); the Goomba entry at 0x6792 is the 11th entry counting from 0x6750. Neighbouring entries are other enemy/sprite forms, e.g. 0x6750 FC A0 A1 A2 A3 A4, 0x6756 69 A5 6A A7 A8 A9, 0x6780 DC DC DD DD DE DE, 0x678C FC FC B6 B3 B7 B5, 0x6798 FC FC 6E 6E 6F 6F, 0x6838 FC FC F0 F0 FC FC. HOW FOUND: search_memory prgRom for the Goomba's tiles in draw order - "FC FC 70 71 72 73" is a unique hit at 0x6792 (a 4-byte "70 71 72 73" search is also unique there). PROOF (ledgered prgRom write + reset + re-reach + undo, hack eval-sheet2-d): write_memory prgRom 0x6794 (the Goomba's upper-left tile) $70 -> $61 (the coin tile; ledger seq 1), reset_emulator, pressed Start and walked Right to the first Goomba. The drawn Goomba changed: list_sprites on the standing Goomba (OAM slots 52-57) read tiles FC FC 61 71 72 73 instead of FC FC 70 71 72 73 - OAM index 54 (cell x=174,y=193) now hit_tile 97 ($61), and get_pixel_color on its opaque pixel (178,197) rendered $0F black / (176,196) $17 brown, i.e. the $61 coin shape in sprite palette 7; the screenshot showed the Goomba's upper-left quadrant replaced (screenshot at the 1-1 bush/hill screen, modified Goomba at screen x~174). Before the edit the same slot read tile $70. undo_edit restored prgRom 0x6794 = $70. So the bytes at 0x6792+ are read by the game and ARE the Goomba's metasprite tile list. Caveat: no direct PRG reader reference to $E7xx exists (only LDA $E73E,X / $E73F,X at prgRom 0x6BAA/0x6BAF, a different pointer table), and trace_writes read on the whole $E700 page over 600 frames caught nothing - the entry is consumed when the enemy/sprite form is set up (spawn/graphics init), not re-read every frame.
rows.why: the note's content matches its graded origins (EnemyGraphicsTable, the Goomba's FC FC 70 71 72 73 entry at 0x6792) and the proof write of tile $61 at 0x6794 drawn as the Goomba's top-right quarter after a reset (this screenshot; a3c15bc3c077.png shows the normal Goomba)
